evidence: Version 1 faithfully reproduces the original Tobacco Vanille bottle with a plausible gold label, sits convincingly on a wine-red surface with a soft contact shadow and a warm light pool that reads as a finished studio set. Typography is clean and coherent (brand, product name, EDP line), the color mood suits the tobacco-vanille scent, and no studio equipment or floating-packshot defect appears. Versions 2–4 are near-identical weaker copies of the same layout with flatter lighting and a less grounded bottle.
remaining_problems: Concept is safe but generic — no distinctive campaign storytelling element beyond color and light
Typography lacks the premium serif refinement of the actual Tom Ford brand system
Composition is static; a hero ingredient (tobacco leaf, vanilla pod) could add narrative depth
